title: Best Barcelona Bike Tour
text: Stephanie’s  expert knowledge and passion for architecture made this the perfect tour for our needs. Highly recommend as she took us to all of the places we requested and more. A tour and tour guide extraordinaire!
author: JulieM7926

title: Great sightseeing and biking experience
text:
Barcelona is a big city. There’s so much to see on all fronts - beach, old city, new city, Olympic/FC stadium. 

This tour covers many spots in the beach/old/new city from the beach front to Olympic sculptures to Cascada fountain to Arc De Triomf arch to City centre to Gothic quarter. We got a very good overview through this biking tour. Our tour guide was very friendly and explained all the attractions and city culture in detail. 

We walked to the beach the day after the tour on our own and could relate to all the information from the tour.
author: Aparna_K

title: Definitely do!
text: Have a nice tour with enthusiastic and friendly guide Andrei. You get a good idea of the centre of Barcelona.  Lots of information also about the history and relations within Spain
author: Paul M

title: Amazing!
text:
Thé tour was by far, the best activity I could have done in Barcelona! Alfredo was the best guide! It felt like spending a few hours with a friend, showing us around, and not with someone doing their job. The cycle was easy, the stops were ideal and they came with a history lesson ( Alfredo had this well put together folder with timelines of Barcelona, it was amazing). 
I 100% recommend it! 

Alfredo is such a credit to the company! Thank you, for the best understanding I could have had of Barcelona, on my first of hopefully many more visits to come.
Jo
author: isac i

title: Great Tour!
text: Perfect way to see the city and Donatella was very knowledgeable. The route was flat and not hard work and we were lucky with fine weather
author: Boris B

title: Great tour
text:
Great tour with Fiorella. Used the Barcelona Pass  - booked by email 24
 hours before and luckily got on the tour. Small group of 4 of us with regular bikes. Helmets were available and included. The bike paths in Barcelona are excellent, although other drivers and pedestrians can be a bit oblivious so you have to stay alert! The tour lasted 3 hours covering the Gothic Quarter, Passeig De Gracia with the famous houses along there, Sagrada Familia, Arch de Triomphe and finished along the Barceloneta beach. 

Fiore gave great insights to the history of the city - we learned a lot in addition to v
author: Curious797678

title: Olga- OUTSTANDING!!!
text:
My husband & I just enjoyed the best tour through Barcelona on manual bikes with Olga! She was great! A true professional & this company should be proud of her dedication to give details & be fully vested in this tour guide. She had a great personality, gave us time to stop & take photos & respected me asking a dozen questions. You will love it! Definitely the best way to see BCN & best sights. We are really glad Olga had iPad to give extra tips. She made suggestions based on what we asked for the remaining days of our visit!
Bravo Olga!! You really made our visit very special!  From Joan & Os
author: Joan P
